summary: Santa Ana's official municipal site establishes a local Jefatura de Catastro and cadastral-map maintenance services. Official CNR pages establish national cadastral products and a Santa Ana departmental office. No anonymous public parcel endpoint or safe parcel ID+polygon response was verified; the inspected SNET geoportal SantaAna layer is a non-parcel polygon layer and its bounded query returned 522.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-491-santa-ana.json. Municipal and CNR first-party pages were inspected. Official SNET REST metadata was inspected; bounded service-root and layer-query GET requests returned 522. The CNR online page showed an account/OTP wall. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe lookup, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification disablement was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: Santa Ana municipal Jefatura de Catastro is a verified local custodian based on the official municipal services page. The CNR Santa Ana departmental Oficina de Mantenimiento Catastral is also evidenced, but CNR is a national agency and its product pages do not expose an open parcel API.
routesAttempted: All discovery URLs, route methods, statuses, and outcomes are recorded in city-491-santa-ana.json.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
schemaAndCrs: Non-parcel SNET SantaAna layer metadata reports polygon geometry and EPSG:4326; parcel schema, parcel native ID, and parcel CRS remain unverified.
